info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Closes-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Closure List API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of support tickets that have been marked as closed. This endpoint is essential for customer service teams and support agents who need to track ticket resolution statuses and analyze closure patterns. By utilizing this API, organizations can improve their support processes and enhance customer satisfaction by ensuring timely follow-ups on resolved issues. Typical consumers of this API include support operations managers and data analysts focused on support performance metrics.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to close a specific ticket in the system. Ensure that you provide the necessary ticket information to successfully complete this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to close a ticket in the system. It requires the JSON payload corresponding to the ticket's closing parameters. Ensure to include all necessary details as specified in the schema.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListSupportTicketsClosesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for closing tickets in the operations module.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_204.title: Close Ticket Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the closing operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the operation.

resultId.description: The result ID generated after the close operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket after the close operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the close operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the close operation.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_204.description: Response schema for the operation of closing a ticket.
